mostWorthwhile.text: Following the two kinds of debris to their shared dust glow connected the separate outcomes and showed how grains make otherwise sparse space visible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the rocky fragments against the cratered world was less worthwhile: the pair did not work, although the feedback still advanced the story.

surprise.text: A rocky impact produced an icy spray from the giant's rings, rather than simply adding rocky debris.

arbitrary.text: The inspection of fine dust automatically included dust and gas from warming ice; that third ingredient was not apparent from the inspection choice, though the resulting mixture made sense.

continue.text: I would continue: tracing material through different encounters was engaging, particularly when the rocky and icy debris came together.
